reward: posture-height minus 0.1 maximum squared segment angular speed / (8 rad/s)^2, minus 1000 once on natural fall; later requests freeze frame with reward zero
optimizer_initialization: deliberate fresh Adam states; retained actor and critic weights

promotion: none; original selection, full early-motion inspection, held-out and native/WASM gates required
